name: Alameda County Library Teen Volunteers (Fremont, Newark, Union City)
city: Fremont, Newark and Union City, CA
what_you_do: Teens can find volunteer roles at Alameda County Library branches through its Better Impact portal.
who_can_apply: Ages and requirements vary by role and are shown on the portal. Not stated on the page I read.
how_to_apply: Browse and apply on the library's Better Impact volunteer portal. Phone 510-745-1500. The application link is on the official page.
notes: The teen page is thin. Ask the Fremont Main Library which roles take teens.
